name: Stdlib language-level wiring for topology-selector function family (PRD §3.9, 11 names)

task_definition.title: Stdlib language-level wiring for topology-selector function family (PRD §3.9, 11 names)
task_definition.description:
Slice (c) of the topology-selectors-PRD wiring debt — closes the gap that 2333's architect surfaced. Per `docs/prds/topology-selectors.md` §3.9, 14 selectors should be callable from .ri-language source. Audit (2026-04-29) found NONE are registered as language-level built-ins; OCCT FFIs and Rust eval impls exist (or are tracked under (d)) but the surface-language registration step was never performed for ANY of them — including the seven from #318 marked done long ago.

| Selector | OCCT FFI | .ri-language registration | Source task |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edges` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `faces` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `edges_by_length` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `faces_by_area` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `faces_by_normal` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `edges_parallel_to` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `edges_at_height` | shipped | MISSING | #318 |
| `closest_point` | shipped (tasks 2828/2832) | DONE (Task 2324) | Task 2324 |
| `on` | shipped (task 2829) | DONE (Task 2324) | Task 2324 |
| `angle_between_surfaces` | shipped (task 2830) | DONE (Task 2324) | Task 2324 |
| `center_of_mass` | shipped | MISSING | #2325 |
| `moment_of_inertia` | shipped | MISSING | #2325 |
| `adjacent_faces` | shipped | MISSING | #2327 |
| `shared_edges` | shipped | MISSING | #2327 |

11 names need new wiring (the 3 closest_point/on/angle_between_surfaces are already done under Task 2324).

## Registration pattern — pre-baked

**`docs/design/topology-selectors-stdlib-registration.md`** (committed 0d4926d5f6 on 2026-05-08) is the design reference. Implementer MUST start there. Key takeaways:

- The answer to α/β/γ is **β with refinement**: Rust-side, name-keyed dispatch with multiple parallel sites. **No central registry. No `.ri` fn declarations needed.** The `.ri` files in `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/*.ri` are for types/traits/units/materials, not surface functions.
- The canonical pattern (established by Task 2324 for `closest_point`/`on`/`angle_between_surfaces`) is a **four-edit template per name**:
  1. `crates/reify-compiler/src/units.rs` — append name to `GEOMETRY_TOPOLOGY_SELECTOR_NAMES` const + add `topology_selector_result_type` arm.
  2. `crates/reify-compiler/src/expr.rs:934` — already wired generically; **no edit per new name** (picks up the const automatically).
  3. `crates/reify-eval/src/geometry_ops.rs:1664` (`try_eval_topology_selector`) — add a `TopologySelectorHelper` enum variant + dispatch arm calling `kernel.query(GeometryQuery::*)`.
  4. `crates/reify-eval/src/engine_build.rs:1344` (`Engine::post_process_topology_selectors`) — already wired generically; **no edit per new name** (post-processes any cell whose default_expr is a recognised selector).
- The relevant kernel-query variants ALREADY EXIST in `crates/reify-types/src/geometry.rs:618` (`AdjacentFaces`, `SharedEdges`, `CenterOfMass`, `InertiaTensor`, `EdgeLength`, `EdgeTangent`, `FaceNormal`, etc.). For the filtered selectors, helper functions in `crates/reify-eval/src/topology_selectors.rs` (`pub fn edges_by_length`, `faces_by_area`, etc.) already do the per-sub-shape iteration and predicate-filtering — the dispatch arm calls them directly.
- The doc gives a complete worked example for `edges` showing every code change.

The design doc also surfaces 8 open questions / risks worth resolving at planning time:
- §4.1 list-element typing (use `Type::List(Box::new(Type::Geometry))` for v0.1, defer Edge/Face discrimination to #2691)
- §4.2 sub-handle vs. int-index list-shape — verify `fillet`'s edges-arg accepts `Value::List(Vec<Value::Int>)` of GeometryHandleIds before finalising the result-type
- §4.3 face-index recovery for `adjacent_faces` / `shared_edges` — likely needs a new `GeometryQuery::FaceIndexOf(sub_handle)` variant or kernel-internal lookup. THIS IS THE LARGEST OPEN QUESTION; may pull `crates/reify-types/src/geometry.rs` and `crates/reify-kernel-occt/src/lib.rs` into the lock footprint.
- §4.4 predicate-arg shape for `faces_by_normal`/`edges_parallel_to` (3-arg with vector + tolerance angle)
- §4.5 `edges_at_height` — verify single-z + tol vs. extent-pair contract
- §4.6 `moment_of_inertia` — dispatch to `InertiaTensor`, not `MomentOfInertia` axis-form
- §4.7 `center_of_mass` already has a snapshot.rs eval_builtin; disambiguation is automatic at runtime (snapshot form takes Map; geometry form takes a named_steps GeometryHandleId via `try_eval_topology_selector`). MUST add a unit test pinning both call shapes.
- §4.8 lock-footprint risk — all 11 names touch the same const list and same `try_eval_topology_selector` match; serialise sub-merges if sliced.

## Recommended sequencing (from design doc §5)

If keeping as a single task: pre-seed memory_hints with the design doc + four wiring sites in §2; constrain planner to "extend Task 2324 pattern uniformly across N names" rather than re-deriving dispatch.

If sliced (steward's option B): natural split is
- Cluster A (no new query variants): `edges`, `faces`, `center_of_mass`, `moment_of_inertia` — 4 names, pure four-edit template; PRD amendment rides here.
- Cluster B (predicate-arg filtering): `edges_by_length`, `faces_by_area`, `faces_by_normal`, `edges_parallel_to`, `edges_at_height` — 5 names; exercises predicate-arg shape and unit-aware tolerance handling.
- Cluster C (topology-graph with face-index recovery): `adjacent_faces`, `shared_edges` — 2 names; depends on resolving §4.3, may pull in a new `GeometryQuery` variant. Land last.

## Scope: full §3.9 sweep — 11 remaining names

Excludes:
- `single` / `flat_map` — generic list helpers, separate task #2698
- Tensor surface-syntax support (for `moment_of_inertia` return type) — task #2696 (DONE 2026-04-30)
- `closest_point` / `on` / `angle_between_surfaces` — DONE under Task 2324
- closest_point/on/angle_between_surfaces FFI primitives — Tasks 2828/2829/2830/2832 (all done as of 2026-05-06)

## Tests

Per-selector compile_with_stdlib smoke: a fixture `.ri` file calling the selector should produce no error-severity diagnostics. Group selectors by signature shape (no need for 14 separate fixture files); use the `parse_and_compile_with_stdlib` infrastructure exercised in `field_source_kinds_smoke.rs`. End-to-end runtime/numeric coverage is task #2691.

The design doc's §3 worked example for `edges` includes a complete fixture + smoke test pattern that can be replicated.

## PRD amendment (in scope for this task)

Update `docs/prds/topology-selectors.md` task breakdown to add an explicit **task 8: Stdlib language-level wiring** describing the FFI/wiring boundary so future readers don't fall into the same trap. ~5 lines, in-line with the existing task 1–7 entries. The implementer commits this alongside the wiring code so PRD intent stays in sync with reality.

## Files (likely)

- `crates/reify-compiler/src/units.rs` — const list + result-type arms (~20 lines per selector)
- `crates/reify-eval/src/geometry_ops.rs` — `TopologySelectorHelper` enum + dispatch arms in `try_eval_topology_selector` (~15-30 lines per selector)
- `crates/reify-types/src/geometry.rs` — possibly one new `GeometryQuery` variant for §4.3 face-index recovery
- `crates/reify-kernel-occt/src/lib.rs` — possibly one new query arm for §4.3
- Per-selector or grouped smoke fixtures under `crates/reify-eval/tests/` and `examples/topology_selectors/`
- `docs/prds/topology-selectors.md` — task 8 amendment

## Dependencies

- **Task 2324**: DONE — established the 4-edit registration pattern this task extends
- **Task 2696**: DONE 2026-04-30 — Tensor surface-syntax + MomentOfInertia/Density named dimensions (required for moment_of_inertia return type)
- No dep on #2698 (e) — the list helpers are separate

## Out of scope

- `single` / `flat_map` (#2698)
- Runtime/numeric coverage and analytic-formula assertions (#2691)
- Importer-side persistent naming for these selectors against imported BREP shapes — explicitly listed as out-of-scope in the PRD itself
- Tightening `Type::List(Box::new(Type::Geometry))` to discriminated `Edge`/`Face`/`Vertex` types — defer to #2691 or future PRD revision

PRD reference: `docs/prds/topology-selectors.md` §3.9, §scope item 5 ("Stdlib bindings"), §worked-examples.
Design reference: `docs/design/topology-selectors-stdlib-registration.md` (commit 0d4926d5f6).
